purpose: Current-lineage Gate 5 field-quality evidence for the integrated Golden UI candidate. This gate does not claim production readiness.

architecture: Decide → Day → Place is the single Golden UI authority
Place mode exposes the complete scrolling active-place list with one visible Must / Strong / Conditional / Skip role per place and no route-comparison matrix
mobile compact, expanded, and full sheets preserve task truth
route-key camera safety and map controls remain reachable
Smart local-first map and optional Satellite recovery preserve Gate 4 invariants
KO/EN, light/dark, trip truth, rights, and security controls remain coherent
hard_gates: every decisive Golden UI artifact is fresh for this invocation and exact-candidate-bound
a missing, stale, malformed, mismatched, non-clean, non-exact, contradictory, or UNVERIFIED artifact fails closed
native Safari, physical-device, independent visual/usability, and paired performance limits are explicit boundaries

performance.comparison_rule: R14 runtime changes require balanced repeated exact-main-versus-candidate samples in the same environment. A missing or mismatched clean current-main baseline is VERIFY_REQUIRED, never PASS by historical comparison.

acceptance_boundaries.implementation_status: PASS means objective Gate 5 checks passed for the exact candidate; it is not a production-readiness claim.
acceptance_boundaries.independent_review: VERIFY_REQUIRED unless independently supplied, candidate-bound multimodal visual/usability review exists.
acceptance_boundaries.native_safari: VERIFY_REQUIRED when native Safari remote automation is unavailable; Playwright WebKit is not a substitute.
acceptance_boundaries.real_device: VERIFY_REQUIRED when a verifiably real iPhone/iPad is unavailable.
acceptance_boundaries.performance: VERIFY_REQUIRED when current-lineage measurements lack an exact same-environment paired base.
acceptance_boundaries.rights: Photo and third-party redistribution rights are outside this gate.
